title: One style can be put on several layers at once
goal: Right now a saved color has to be applied to one layer at a time. Select three boxes and set them all to the same named color in one go.
notes: Follow-up from queue/audits/2026-09-03-color-styles.json. Model side already supports it: bindColorStyle takes one layer, so this is a loop plus the multi-selection reading in the inspector. ColorStyleRow/ColorStyleControl in Sources/Photonz/ColorStylePanel.swift take a single layerID today.
acceptance: With more than one layer selected, the color row offers the styles menu and applying a style paints every selected layer that has that kind of color
Applying to a multi-selection is one undo step
A selection mixing layers that wear different styles says so rather than claiming one of them
